# ArtCraft fixtures

Ordinary tests use temporary workspaces outside the AVO checkout. The provider
identity, speaker label, shape layers, media patterns and application observations
are synthetic. Generate neutral graphics and tones within each test. Keep native
documents and rendered media from actual trials in the declared external workspace.
For any separately sourced font, media or plugin, record its identity, source and
usage rights with that trial. The repository carries the test inputs and validators.

The ten representative native tasks require the selected app and compatible CLI
to be installed separately. Configure the exact required executable, operation
and authorized roots for an opt-in trial.

| App | Specific native fixture dependency |
| --- | --- |
| AniCraft | Editable text and vector badge with tween timing and transparent frames |
| EffectCraft | Editable text, shape and matte with bounded layer effects and transparent export |
| FilmCraft | Short labeled source clips and a source-linked returned timeline |
| SoundCraft | Synthetic isolated cue, matched sample rate and a documented built-in effect |
| VectorCraft | Editable neutral vector emblem with a supported SVG exchange |
| PhotoCraft | Layered card, color profile and independently inspected flattened export |
| LightCraft | Isolated job-owned library, neutral photo and reusable treatment |
| FigCraft | Editable brand card, content variant and declared static exchange loss |
| TextureCraft | Job-owned mesh, editable material and checked texture channels |
| DeckCraft | Editable slide with a declared layout and an inspected exported frame |

Record the selected release/platform/mode, effective roots, saved native source,
fresh reopen and export observations for each actual trial. A missing application,
mode, dependency or review remains pending with its specific reason. Synthetic
adapter responses establish AVO behavior and carry no native qualification.
